hero.title: Join Our Team
hero.subtitle: Help us redefine fashion retail in Ghana
hero.description: We're building something special — a brand that Ghanaians trust for authentic, high-quality footwear. We need passionate people to join us on this journey.

benefits.title: Competitive Salary
benefits.description: Above-market compensation packages with performance bonuses and salary reviews twice a year.

benefits.title: Health Insurance
benefits.description: Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. Medical, dental, and vision included.

benefits.title: Employee Discounts
benefits.description: 40% discount on all S&S Fashion products. Plus exclusive access to new collections before public launch.

benefits.title: Training & Development
benefits.description: Annual learning budget, conference attendance, and online course subscriptions. We invest in your growth.

benefits.title: Paid Time Off
benefits.description: 25 days annual leave, plus public holidays. Additional personal days when you need them.

benefits.title: Remote Flexibility
benefits.description: Hybrid work model with 3 days in-office and 2 days remote. We trust our team to manage their time.

positions.title: Social Media Manager
positions.description: Lead our social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter. Create engaging content that resonates with our audience.
requirements: Strong understanding of Ghanaian social media landscape
Experience with content creation tools (Canva, Adobe Suite)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

positions.title: Photographer / Videographer
positions.description: Capture high-quality product photos and brand videos for our e-commerce platform and social media channels.
requirements: Experience with studio and outdoor shoots
Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, Final Cut)
Own equipment (camera, lighting, basic studio setup)

testimonials.name: Kofi Mensah
testimonials.quote: Working at S&S Fashion has been the most rewarding experience of my career. The team is incredibly supportive, and I've grown more here in 2 years than in my previous 5 years elsewhere.

testimonials.name: Ama Darko
testimonials.quote: What I love most is that my ideas actually get heard and implemented. Management genuinely cares about employee feedback, and we see real changes based on our suggestions.
